entries.source: They possess the #GOLD#Dominant Will#WHITE# talent which allows them to temporarily subvert the mind of a lesser creature. When the effect ends, the creature dies.
entries.target: 他们天生掌握#GOLD#主导意志#WHITE#技能，使他们能在短时间内控制一个较弱生物的思维。当效果结束时，被控制目标死亡。

entries.source: The known world has been at relative peace for over one hundred years, and people are prospering again.
entries.target: 已知世界已经保持了一百多年的相对和平，人们再次繁荣起来。

entries.source: If so, you will battle your own champion next time!
entries.target: 如果成功，下次挑战竞技场时，你将与自己的冠军角色交战！

entries.source: Pyre
entries.target: 烈火月

entries.source: Decay
entries.target: 凋零月

entries.source: Pfaugh. You're too late. %s has already finished. But I suppose it doesn't do any harm to take these and give you your undeserved reward.
entries.target: 呸！你来太晚了。%s已经完成了。不过收下这些原料、把你不配得到的奖励给你，倒也没什么坏处。

entries.source: Ah, excellent. Hand them over, if you please. You should know that in your overlong absence, %s has managed to create a %s. I'll be most put out if he steals my rightful spot.
entries.target: 啊，太好了。请把它们交给我吧。要知道，在你离开的漫长时间里，%s已经设法配制出了一瓶%s。要是他抢走了本该属于我的席位，我可会非常不悦。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A human robed in immaculate white satin opens the door and eyes you appraisingly.*#WHITE#
Ah, an adventurer. I was just thinking that I needed a new one.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名身着一尘不染白缎长袍的人类打开了门，审视地打量着你。*#WHITE#
啊，一位冒险者。我正想着我需要个新的帮手呢。

entries.source: That sounds promising. And ominous.
entries.target: 听起来挺有希望。但也透着不祥。

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source: Indeed, it is both promising and ominous. I can reward you handsomely for your efforts, but they will lead you into deadly peril to which, I assume, the previous three fellows who went off on my errand never to return can attest.
entries.target: 确实，既大有希望，又透着不祥。我会为你的效劳提供丰厚的回报，但这也将引你踏入致命险境——我想，前三个替我办事后便一去不回的家伙足以证明这一点。

entries.source: What do you propose?
entries.target: 那……你的建议呢？

entries.source: Good adventurer, I am an alchemist, and quite a good one. This year, for the first time, the great Brotherhood of Alchemists has invited my application to their number. I'll not try your patience with the details of the application process, but suffice to say that it is grueling. Fortunately, a mere three tasks now stand between me and acceptance.
entries.target: 可敬的冒险者，我是一名炼金术士，而且手艺相当精湛。今年，伟大的炼金术士兄弟会首次邀请我申请入会。我就不用申请流程的细节来消磨你的耐心了，简而言之，那极其严苛。幸运的是，现在我与正式入会之间只剩下区区三项任务了。

entries.source: How can I help?
entries.target: 我该如何帮你？

entries.source: I require ingredients for three potent mixtures. Obviously, since I seek your aid, none of them is to be found by simply strolling to the local herbalist's. No, they will need to be forcibly parted from their owners who will, just as obviously, put up a fight. I've yet to encounter a naga who would be persuaded to hand over his tongue! Ha! Oh, I am droll at times.
entries.target: 我需要用于配制三种强效药剂的原料。显而易见，既然我向你求助，这些东西就绝非在本地草药铺随便逛逛就能弄到的。不，它们必须从原主身上强行剥离下来，而同样显而易见的是，对方一定会奋起抵抗。我还没遇到过哪只肯被说服乖乖交出舌头的娜迦呢！哈！噢，我有时候还真挺幽默的。

entries.source: I specialize in separating vital body parts from monsters. What do you offer in return?
entries.target: 从怪物身上剥离关键身体部位正是我的专长。你拿什么作为回报？

entries.source: Why, I will let you share in the fruits of my labors! Each of the three mixtures I shall produce in a quantity sufficient to create three doses: one for me, one for the Brotherhood and their confounded trial... and one for you. I must tell you that time is of the essence. I am not the only one who the Brotherhood invited this year, yet they will accept only one applicant-- the first to complete their trials. I know of at least three others laboring furiously to take my rightful place. Should your aid see me through, then I will reward you beyond even the remarkable elixirs. I've an ancient Lifebinding Emerald that grants great powers of health and healing when used properly. What say you?
entries.target: 哎呀，我会让你分享我的劳动成果！这三种药剂，我每种都会配制出足够三份的剂量：一份归我，一份交给兄弟会去应付他们那该死的考验……还有一份归你。我必须告诉你，时间至关重要。我并非兄弟会今年邀请的唯一人选，而他们只录取一名申请者——最先完成考验的那位。我知道至少还有其他三个人在拼命劳作，想抢夺本该属于我的席位。若在你的帮助下我得以胜出，我给予你的报酬甚至会超越那些非凡的药剂。我有一块古老的生命绑定翡翠，妥善使用时能赋予强大的生命与治疗力量。你意下如何？

entries.source: I accept.
entries.target: 我接受了。

entries.source: I cannot aid you at this time.
entries.target: 我现在没空帮你。

entries.source: Excellent. Now then, I've three elixirs I'm working on. I'll burden you with only one at a time, since I've learned the hard way about the hazards of overloading an adventurer's brain. Here are your options: the elixir of the fox, which makes you as nimble and cunning as a fox; the elixir of avoidance, which sharpens your natural inclinations to get out of the way of incoming harm; or the elixir of precision, which grants intuitive understanding of an enemy's most sensitive spots. Which would you like to aid me with?
entries.target: 太好了。那么，我目前正在研制三种药剂。我每次只交给你一项，毕竟我曾吃过苦头，深知让冒险者的大脑负荷过重有多危险。以下是你的选择：狡诈药剂，能让你如狐狸般敏捷狡黠；闪避药剂，能磨砺你躲避来袭伤害的本能；或是精准药剂，能让你凭直觉洞悉敌人最脆弱的要害。你想协助我制作哪一种？

entries.source: The %s.

Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please attempt to not lose your life in their pursuit. I'll be most put out if I must wait another year. Oh, and I suppose I should tell you that I've already a handful of adventurers out scouring the unpleasant places of the world for these ingredients. Dally and one of them shall claim the prize while you're out.
entries.target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。搜寻它们时请尽量保住性命，要是还得再等上一年，我可会非常不快的。噢，我想我还得告诉你，我已经派了几个冒险者去世间那些险恶之地搜寻这些原料了。若是拖拖拉拉，当你还在外奔波时，奖品就已经被其中某人领走了。

entries.source: I'll be off.
entries.target: 我走了。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

entries.source: [Leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist opens his door.*#WHITE#
Ah, you again.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士打开了门。*#WHITE#
啊，又是你。

entries.source: I've returned with the ingredients for the %s.
entries.target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料。

entries.source: I've come to offer more aid.
entries.target: 我来提供更多帮助。

entries.source: [Give him the monster bits.]
entries.target: [给他材料。]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist grins and motions impatiently for the ingredients.*#WHITE#
Wonderful, absolutely wonderful! The final step! Here, let me have those!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士咧嘴一笑，急不可耐地示意你交出原料。*#WHITE#
太棒了，真是太棒了！最后一步了！快，把那些交给我！

entries.source: [Give him the monster bits]
entries.target: [给他材料]

entries.source: Wait here while I perform my art. I'll have your reward within the hour.
entries.target: 在这儿等着，容我施展技艺。一小时内我就会备好你的报酬。

entries.source: [Wait]
entries.target: [等待]

entries.source: A final wait for you, my good adventurer, and then I shall return with both your rewards! Haha, complete at last!
entries.target: 最后稍等片刻，我可敬的冒险者，随后我就会带着你的两份奖励归来！哈哈，终于大功告成了！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns and hands you a small vial of fine glass.*#WHITE#
Enjoy your reward.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于回来了，递给你一只精致的小玻璃药瓶。*#WHITE#
享用你的奖励吧。

entries.source: Thank you. I'll be off.
entries.target: 谢谢，我走了。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns with a vial and a green gem.*#WHITE#
Enjoy the fruits of your labors, adventurer. I know I will. To show my appreciation, I shall name my firstborn after... er, what was your name, then? Haha, I jest. Oh, I do go on when I'm giddy. Fare you well.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于带着一只药瓶和一颗绿色宝石回来了。*#WHITE#
尽情享用你的辛劳成果吧，冒险者。反正我肯定会好好享用我的这份。为表谢意，我打算用你的名字为我的头胎孩子命名……呃，你叫什么名字来着？哈哈，开个玩笑。噢，我一兴奋起来话就停不下来。祝你一路顺风。

entries.source: Excellent. With which would you like to aid me?
entries.target: 太好了。你想协助我制作哪一种？

entries.source: Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please attempt to not lose your life in their pursuit. I'll be most put out if I must wait another year.
entries.target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。搜寻它们时请尽量保住性命，要是还得再等上一年，我可会非常不快的。

entries.source: Terribly sorry, but I've already made the elixir without your aid. I've no reward to give you, and no reason to do so if I did.
entries.target: 实在抱歉，但无需你的协助，我就已经配制好了这瓶药剂。我没有奖励可以给你，即便有，我也毫无理由这么做。

entries.source: Hrmph.
entries.target: 哼。

entries.source: Too late! Argh, too late. %s has already finished. I'll make the elixir and reward you as promised, but only because the Brotherhood breaks the fingers of non-member alchemists who rook people. Members, on the other hand...
entries.target: 太迟了！啊，太迟了！%s已经完成了。我会按承诺配制药剂并给你奖励，但这纯粹是因为兄弟会会折断那些坑蒙拐骗的非会员炼金术士的手指。至于会员嘛，可就另当别论了……

entries.source: Give them here. You took long enough; %s cooked up a %s in your absence. Be quicker about the next one lest I make a 'mistake' in brewing your reward.
entries.target: 拿来吧。你可真够磨蹭的；趁你不在的时候，%s已经捣鼓出了一瓶%s。下一次手脚麻利点，免得我在酿造你的奖励时“不小心出错”。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A shabbily-dressed elf opens the door, scratching his head in apparent puzzlement.*#WHITE#
Another adventurer? Or have we met? I can't tell people apart unless they wear brightly-colored headbands. You need to help me.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名衣衫褴褛的精灵打开了门，抓着头，显得十分困惑。*#WHITE#
又一个冒险者？还是我们见过？除非头上戴着色彩鲜艳的发带，否则我根本分不清谁是谁。你得帮帮我。

entries.source: I am indeed an adventurer. Go on.
entries.target: 我确实是名冒险者。请继续说。

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source: Three elixirs stand between me and acceptance into the Brotherhood of Alchemists, unless I've been through that already. I'm never quite sure. But I think that's the case. Bring me the ingredients.
entries.target: 我只差三瓶药剂就能被炼金术士兄弟会接纳——除非我已经经历过这一切了。我从来都不太确定。但我猜情况就是这样。去把原料给我找来。

entries.source: What elixirs? What ingredients?
entries.target: 什么药剂？什么原料？

entries.source: The ones that I need to get before the other alchemists get them. Can't have some lesser hack sneaking into the Brotherhood.
entries.target: 就是我必须赶在其他炼金术士得手前弄到的那些。绝不能让哪个不入流的庸才混进兄弟会。

entries.source: You're making little sense.
entries.target: 你这话前言不搭后语。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He raises his voice and gestures exaggeratedly, seemingly taking you for an idiot.*#WHITE#
Me need pieces of scary monsters for happy-making drink. You get me pieces. You probably get eaten by monsters, me have this conversation yet again with other bonehead.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他提高了嗓门，夸张地比画着手势，似乎把你当成了白痴。*#WHITE#
我要可怕怪物的碎块做快乐药水。你，去帮我拿碎块。你八成会被怪物吃掉，然后我又得跟别的蠢蛋把这些话再讲一遍。

entries.source: I've been known to kill the occasional monster. Is there a reward in it for me?
entries.target: 我偶尔也会杀杀怪物。我能从中得到什么报酬？

entries.source: It finally understands! You get a dose of every elixir you help me make. And if your help gets me into the Brotherhood, I've got half an Elixir of Invulnerability lying around that I'll give you. Don't try anything; I've already downed the other half.
entries.target: “它”总算听懂了！你每帮我制作一种药剂，就能分得一份剂量。要是你的协助能让我入选兄弟会，我这儿碰巧还留着半瓶无敌药剂可以送给你。别想动什么歪脑筋，另外半瓶早就被我喝光了。

entries.source: I accept.
entries.target: 我接受了。

entries.source: I cannot aid you at this time.
entries.target: 我现在没空帮你。

entries.source: Three elixirs I need. I'll show you the ingredients to one at a time. Are you interested in the Elixir of Mysticism, the Elixir of the Savior, or the Elixir of Mastery?
entries.target: 我需要三种药剂。我每次只告诉你一种药剂所需的原料。神秘药剂、守护药剂和掌握药剂，你对哪一种感兴趣？

entries.source: The %s.

Here's a list of the monster bits I need. I've already got a bunch of idiots out looking for these, by the way, so you best hurry up; they've got a head start on you and I'm not getting any saner here.
entries.target: 这是我需要的怪物部位清单。顺便说一句，我已经派了一帮蠢货在外面搜寻这些东西了，所以你最好快点；他们可比你先行一步，而我呆在这儿可不会变得越来越清醒。

entries.source: So I see. I'll be off.
entries.target: 看出来了。我这就出发。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*The door is locked and nobody responds to your knocks*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*门锁着，无人回应你的敲门声*#WHITE#

entries.source: [Leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The shabby elf opens his door.*#WHITE#
Do I know you?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*衣衫褴褛的精灵打开了门。*#WHITE#
我认识你吗？

entries.source: I've returned with the ingredients for the %s.
entries.target: 我回来了，我找到了%s的材料。

entries.source: I've come to offer more aid.
entries.target: 我来提供更多帮助。

entries.source: [Give him the monster bits.]
entries.target: [给他材料。]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The elf claps his scarred hands together.*#WHITE#
Exceptional work, lackey! The final elixir awaits! Oh, yes. Membership will be mine. And revenge. Ohhhh yes.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*精灵拍了拍他那满是伤疤的双手。*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，跟班！最后的药剂就在眼前！噢，没错。会员席位非我莫属。还有复仇。噢——没错。

entries.source: [Give him the monster bits]
entries.target: [给他材料]

entries.source: Contain your impatience while I prepare these. I'll have the elixir within the hour.
entries.target: 我调配这些原料时，你耐着性子等着。一小时内我就能备好药剂。

entries.source: [Wait]
entries.target: [等待]

entries.source: Perfection. Wait here.
entries.target: 完美。在这儿候着。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The elf finally returns and tosses you a small vial of fine glass.*#WHITE#
Side effects may include some slight mental imbalances.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*精灵终于回来了，抛给你一只精致的小玻璃药瓶。*#WHITE#
副作用可能包括轻微的精神失衡。

entries.source: Thank you. I'll be off.
entries.target: 谢谢，我走了。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The alchemist finally returns with two vials.*#WHITE#
I have no idea who you are, but I'm pretty sure that I'm supposed to give these to somebody as a reward. If some adventurer kills you and takes them, then apparently you're not the fellow I'm looking for.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*炼金术士终于带着两只药瓶回来了。*#WHITE#
我根本不知道你是谁，但我很确定这些是要作为奖励交给某个人的。要是有哪个冒险者把你杀了抢走它们，那显然你并不是我要找的那个家伙。

entries.source: Which of the remaining elixirs interests you?
entries.target: 剩下的药剂中，你对哪一种感兴趣？

entries.source: Here's a list of the ingredients I'm missing. Please follow the directions carefully, or the resulting elixir could be more fatal than either of us would hope.
entries.target: 这是我所缺少的原料清单。请务必严格遵循说明，否则配制出的药剂可能会比我们双方所希望的更加致命。

entries.source: I'll be off.
entries.target: 我走了。

entries.source: Already made it. Best pick up the pace next time, adventurer.
entries.target: 已经做好了。下次动作最好快点，冒险者。

entries.source: Hrmph.
entries.target: 哼。
